title: Steel panel enclosure, 400 × 500 × 200 mm, backplate and two DIN rails

sources.citation: real-world (product class): 400 × 500 × 200 mm single-door wall-mount sheet-steel enclosures are catalogued by several makers with 1.5 mm body steel, UL Type 1/3R/4/12 ratings (UL 50/50E, NEMA 250 by number) and a 350 × 450 mm mounting plate of 2–2.5 mm galvanised steel; distributor listings read 2026-11-12. Drawn walls 2 mm (rounded up), so the inside is 396 × 496 × 198 mm. The door is not modelled (the front is open).

game-design: computed from the inside dimensions above as a plain rectangular volume, 396 × 496 × 198 = 38890368 mm³. Box fill (P4) doesn't apply to a panel enclosure; it is stored for completeness and is not from any code table.

real-world: the 35 mm top-hat rail TS 35 × 7.5 (IEC 60715, cited by number), 7.5 mm deep (drawn 8 mm, so a device clipped on clears it), and the 90 mm overall height (45 mm front) of modular devices (DIN 43880, cited by number): a mounted device's bottom edge sits 45 mm below the rail centreline, so a 90 mm device is centred on its rail and others sit off-centre (ADR 0015's mount origin).

game-design: the rails are 330 mm long from x = 35 mm, their centrelines 350 and 175 mm above the enclosure's bottom, screwed to the backplate (front face at z = 14 mm), so a device's back is at z = 22 mm; not taken from a product drawing.

game-design: a 350 × 450 mm backplate (mounting plate), 2 mm thick (2–2.5 mm in the class), standing 10 mm off the inside face of the back wall on studs; parts may be fixed anywhere on a 350 mm square of it from its lower-left corner (an area mount is a square until a backplate declares its second extent, ADR 0015 implementation note 7). The rails are drawn on it but are not bodies: a part fixed to the plate over a rail is not refused.

game-design: two 3/4 in and one 1 in trade-size knockouts in the bottom, and two drill sites for 3/4 in connectors in the top (opened with a hole saw or punch, F3.4 part 2), one connector each; positions are on the outside wall faces and are not taken from a product drawing.
